description: This file defines feature flags as an enum, provides functions to initialize and check feature flags, and references external modules for logging and global window object. It is used for managing feature toggles within the application.

methods.name: initFeatureFlags
methods.description: Initializes feature flags in the global window object if not already set.

methods.name: isFeatureEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific feature flag is enabled based on the global window object.
